title: Libre 2 - (xDrip+ + LibreLink patched). 2nd Libre2 sensor
body:
Hello,

I stopped my sensor and setup a new one physically. Before that I stopped xDrip sensor. After the warmup phase of 60min I started the xDrip sensor again and set the beginning of today. 

I don't know why but the Logs only showing : MissedReadeingService: Agressivly restarting collector...blabla.
Screenshot: https://imgur.com/a/Ost6661

I think I have a BT connection to my Libre2 cause the patched app does not have a question mark. The log said 'lack of reception' so it's a issue of xDrip? xDrip can't reach the app or ?

Pixel 4a 5G
xDrip+ e14bae1-2020.07.13

Is it a feature or a bug?

Thanks in advance
